beaches.name: Vathy (Gythio)
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is established mid-beach between Camping Zeus and Mikro Chorio. A naturist directory carries independent visitor reports from 2017 to 2020 calling that middle section fully nudist, with the rest of the bay in swimwear. No designation or signage is documented.

beaches.name: Simos
beaches.summary: Recent reports find no nude bathing at Simos; older reports describe nudist use. A naturist directory carries nudist-use reports up to 2014 at the north end of the big beach, then 2016-2022 reports of a fully clothed beach and a police warning that naturism is forbidden on the island.
